meta_title: Cross-Paper Insights for Car-Control Agent Evaluation
meta_title_zh: 跨论文洞察：车控 Agent 评测的关键方向

cross_cutting_themes.theme_zh: 从静态到有状态的评测范式转变
cross_cutting_themes.description: BFCL v4, ToolSandbox, TRAJECT-Bench, and τ²-bench all converge on the same finding: single-turn, stateless evaluation overestimates real-world performance by 15-30%. The field is unanimously moving toward stateful, multi-turn, trajectory-aware evaluation.
cross_cutting_themes.car_control_action: Our eval set should prioritize multi-turn scenarios (currently 26/207 = 12.5%). Target: 25-30% multi-turn. Add explicit vehicle state tracking across turns in each multi-turn case.

cross_cutting_themes.theme_zh: 三层评测架构：结果 → 轨迹 → 逐轮
cross_cutting_themes.description: The Agent Survey (ACL 2026), ToolSandbox, and MCP-AgentBench independently propose three evaluation layers: (1) final-answer/state verification, (2) trajectory/tool-call correctness, (3) per-turn interaction quality. This maps naturally to our action/state/label assertion types.
cross_cutting_themes.car_control_action: Our assertion system (action=layer 1, state=layer 2, label=layer 3) already implements this architecture. Next step: add trajectory-level scoring for hard combo cases using Milestone DAG approach.

cross_cutting_themes.theme: Similar Tool Confusion is the Dominant Failure Mode
cross_cutting_themes.theme_zh: 相似工具混淆是最主要的失败模式
cross_cutting_themes.description: TRAJECT-Bench, API-Bank, and BFCL all identify 'similar tool confusion' as the #1 failure mode: models pick wrong tools when descriptions overlap. This directly validates our L1-TL-09 (工具描述歧义敏感度) tag and our shade_curtain_opener vs shade_curtain_switch case.
cross_cutting_themes.car_control_action: Expand L1-TL-09 from 3 to 8 cases covering more similar-tool pairs: mirror_fold vs mirror_adjust, fragrance_switch vs fragrance_mode, conditioner_temperature vs conditioner_speed.

cross_cutting_themes.theme: Negative Examples Are Essential but Under-Provided
cross_cutting_themes.theme_zh: 负例不可或缺但普遍供给不足
cross_cutting_themes.description: MetaTool shows models over-trigger tools 20-40% of the time, yet most benchmarks have <10% negative cases. Our 15% negative ratio is above average but still below the ideal 20-25% suggested by MetaTool's findings.
cross_cutting_themes.car_control_action: Increase negative cases from 32 (15%) to ~45 (20%+). Focus on subtle negatives: parameter-legal but semantically wrong commands, tool over-triggering in ambiguous contexts, and cross-domain confusion.

cross_cutting_themes.theme: Memory and Personalization Are Critical Gaps
cross_cutting_themes.theme_zh: 记忆与个性化是评测的关键空白
cross_cutting_themes.description: CarMem, VehicleMemBench, and the Agent Survey all identify long-term memory and personalization as the most under-evaluated capability. Our 22 memory-dependent cases (L1-MM-01~05) are among the first to systematically test this in a car-control context.
cross_cutting_themes.car_control_action: Our memory taxonomy (L1-L5 with L1-MM-01~05) is already best-in-class. Next: design end-to-end multi-session test scenarios where preferences persist across simulated days/weeks.

cross_cutting_themes.theme_zh: 可复现性依赖于 API 稳定性
cross_cutting_themes.description: StableToolBench demonstrates that real API benchmarks degrade 15-30% within 6 months. Our tools_manifest.json (547 tools, versioned) provides the stable API snapshot that StableToolBench recommends.
cross_cutting_themes.car_control_action: Version-lock tools_manifest.json with each eval set release. Add API version metadata to eval_cases.json. Design simulated tool servers for CI/CD reproducibility.

what_we_have: Versioned tool manifest (547 tools in 10 groups)
what_benchmarks_have_that_we_dont: Real-time tool execution with state simulation
Standardized leaderboard with public model rankings
Multi-language function calling (Python + Java + REST + SQL)
what_we_have_that_benchmarks_dont: Vehicle-specific state model (speed, seats, climate, partitions)
Chinese natural speech with oral noise (14% coverage)
